topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Oh man, I just got this package, and it's not even for me! It's got the name of some previous tenant on it, and I was just like, what the heck do I do now? I mean, I opened it by accident, thinking it was for me, you know? Inside, there's just some random stuff, like old cables and a couple of books. I'm thinking I should probably put it all back together, seal it up, and try to find the right person. But how do you even do that? It’s like, do I call the post office? Or maybe the previous tenant left a forwarding address? Any advice would be a huge help!
